segments.text: What is the special importance of a telescope in space?
segments.translation: 太空中的望远镜有什么特殊的重要性？

segments.text: The Hubble telescope was launched into
space by NASA on April 20, 1990 at a cost of over a billion dollars.
segments.translation: 由美国航空航天局发射升空，造价超过10亿美元。

segments.text: Right from the start there was trouble with the Hubble.
segments.translation: 从一开始哈勃就有问题。

segments.text: The pictures it sent us were very disappointing because its main mirror was faulty!
segments.translation: 它传送给我们的图像非常令人失望，因为它的主反光镜有毛病！

segments.text: NASA is now going to put the telescope right,
segments.translation: 美国航空航天局现在准备修复这台望远镜，

segments.text: so it will soon be sending up four astronauts to repair it.
segments.translation: 因此不久就会送4名宇航员上去修理它。

segments.text: The shuttle Endeavour will be taking the astronauts to the Hubble.
segments.translation: 奋进号航天飞机将把宇航员送到哈勃望远镜那里。

segments.text: A robot-arm from the Endeavour will grab the telescope and hold it while the astronauts make the necessary repairs.
segments.translation: 奋进号上的一只机械手将抓住望远镜并在宇航员进行必要的修理时托住它。

segments.text: Of course, the Hubble is above the earth's atmosphere,
segments.translation: 当然，哈勃在地球的大气层之外，

segments.text: so it will soon be sending us the clearest pictures of the stars and distant galaxies that we have ever seen.
segments.translation: 因此它不久就能给我们发送我们所见过的最清晰的恒星和远距离星系的图片。

segments.text: The Hubble will tell us a great deal about the age and size of the universe.
segments.translation: 哈勃将告诉我们大量有关宇宙年龄和大小的信息。

segments.text: By the time you read this, the Hubble's eagle eye will have sent us thousands and thousands of wonderful pictures.
segments.translation: 当你读到这篇文章时，哈勃的鹰眼将已经发回了成千上万张精彩的图片。
